description: Trusted ground-truth eval set for grading the local model's judgment quality, distilled from Haiku-era merges and independently verified by an Opus audit (see git commit history around 1ad76d2). Of the original 10 Haiku merges, only these 2 held up as biologically sound and specific enough to trust as a general rule -- the other 8 were REJECTED (wrong mechanism, or generic text_pattern signal) or QUESTIONABLE (right idea, real specificity leak) on closer inspection, several resting on circular ortholog-pair agreement now blocked by independent_accessions() in merge_llm_findings.py. Do not add more terms to this file without the same level of independent verification -- that's the whole point of it being small.

GO:0000035.name: acyl binding
GO:0000035.definition: Binding to an acyl group, any group formally derived by removal of the hydroxyl group from the acid function of a carboxylic acid.

GO:0000156.name: phosphorelay response regulator activity
GO:0000156.definition: Responds to a phosphorelay sensor to initiate a change in cell state or activity. The activity of the response regulator is regulated by transfer of a phosphate from a histidine residue in the sensor, to an aspartate residue in the response regulator. Many but not all response regulators act as transcriptional regulators to elicit a response.
